original: アーチェのほうきって便利だよね〜。\n飛べるし、いざとなったら掃除にも\n使えちゃいそうだし
traducao: Arche's broom is so handy, huh?\nYou can fly, and if needed,\nyou can even clean with it!

original: へ？　\nそーお？
traducao: Huh?\nYou think so?

original: って、それ程でもあったり\nしちゃうんだけどね〜！　\nへへっ♪
traducao: Well, I suppose it's not\nthaaat big a deal, but still!\nHeheh~

original: そういうアニスだって、トクナガだっけ？\nあれ、超便利そうじゃん
traducao: Though speaking of that, Anise,\nTokunaga seems super handy too!

original: 普段はちっちゃいのに、戦闘の時だけ\nすっごい巨大化してさ〜！
traducao: It's tiny normally, but grows\nsuper huge during battle!

original: えへへ〜。\nありがと∀
traducao: Ehehe~\nThank you!

original: トクナガは、知り合いが作ってくれたんだけど\nもうほとんど体の一部みたいなものかなあ
traducao: An acquaintance made Tokunaga,\nbut he's practically part of me now!

original: あ〜わかるわかる。\nそういう愛着って、大事だよねえ！
traducao: Ah, I totally get that!\nHaving that kind of love is important!

original: ね、コレットはどう思う？
traducao: Hey, what do you think, Colette?

original: 私？
traducao: Me?

original: 私は、あれがいいかなぁ……
traducao: I think that one is the best...

original: あれって……ユージーンじゃん？
traducao: That one... You mean Eugene?!

original: 何か持ってたっけ？
traducao: Was he carrying something?

original: はうあ、一撃！
traducao: Whoa, instant KO!

original: 尻尾袋を外せば\n空気中の湿気で、明日のお天気とかも\nわかっちゃうみたいだよ
traducao: If you take off his tail pouch,\nthe humidity tells him tomorrow's\nweather, apparently!

original: うう〜〜……、あんなのズルイ
traducao: Uuuuugh... That's so unfair!

original: ほんとに体の一部だもんね
traducao: That really is a part of the body!

original: それに、ふさふさしてて可愛いよ∀
traducao: Plus, it's so fluffy and cute!

original: むぅ、機能性に加えてギャップ萌えまで……
traducao: Hmph, functionality plus gap moe...

original: 侮りがたし……
traducao: Not to be underestimated...

original: ユージーン！
traducao: Eugene!

original: ユージーンって\n教師に向いてそうだよなぁ
traducao: Eugene really seems suited\nto being a teacher, doesn't he?

original: これまで、教師になろうって\n考えた事はないのか？
traducao: Have you ever thought about\nbecoming a teacher before?

original: 特に考えた事はないが……
traducao: I've never specifically considered it...

original: へへっ、こっちこっち〜！
traducao: Heheh, over here, over here~!

original: もう、マオってば！\n待ってよ〜
traducao: Geez, Mao!\nWait up~!

original: オニの言う事なんて\n聞けないヨ〜♪
traducao: I don't listen\nto the tagger~!

original: ほら、こっちこっち！
traducao: C'mon, over here, over here!

original: 言ったな。よ〜し
traducao: You said it! All right...

original: そっちがその気なら、こっちだって……！
traducao: If that's how you want it, then I'll...!

original: こら、二人とも
traducao: Hey, both of you.

original: こんな狭い通路で追いかけっこなんか\nするんじゃない
traducao: Do not play tag\nin such a narrow hallway.

original: 遊ぶなら、もっと広い場所で遊ぶんだ。\n危ないだろう
traducao: If you want to play, find a wider area.\nIt's dangerous here.

original: は〜い
traducao: Yeees.

original: もう……。\nマオが無茶するから、\nボクまで怒られちゃったじゃないか
traducao: Jeez...\nBecause Mao went wild,\nI got scolded too!

original: え〜？　\nボクのせいなの？\nジーニアスだって乗り気だったじゃない
traducao: Ehh?!\nIt's my fault?\nGenis was eager to play too!

original: それは、マオが……
traducao: That's because Mao was...

original: 遊んでいたのは二人だろう
traducao: Both of you were playing.

original: 二人とも、反省をするべきだ
traducao: Both of you ought to reflect on that.

original: は〜い……
traducao: Okaaaay...

original: ははっ
traducao: Haha.

original: やっぱりユージーンは\n教師に向いているよ
traducao: See, Eugene is definitely\ncut out to be a teacher!

original: ど、どうかな？\n俺……どこかおかしいかな
traducao: S-So how is it?\nIs... something wrong with me?

original: ……いや、俺の見た限りでは\n特に異常は見当たらないな
traducao: ...No, as far as I can see,\nthere is nothing out of the ordinary.

original: 強いて言うなら、健康そのものだ
traducao: If anything, you're perfectly healthy.

original: 良かった
traducao: What a relief.

original: さぁ、次はお前だ。\nこっちへ来なさい
traducao: Now then, you are next.\nCome over here.

original: ク……クィッキー……
traducao: Qui... Quickie...

original: おいおい
traducao: Hey now.

original: そう怯えなくてもいい
traducao: No need to be so frightened.

original: ただ、毛並みや爪、皮膚の具合を\n簡単に見せてもらうだけだ
traducao: I merely wish to check\nyour fur, claws, and skin condition.

original: クィ……？
traducao: Quii...?

original: ク、クィ…………クィッキー！！
traducao: Qui, quii...... Quickieee!!

original: はは、そうだ。\nいい子だな
traducao: Haha, that's it.\nGood creature.

original: あの……さっきから思ってたんですけど\n何をしているんですか？
traducao: Um... I've been wondering,\nwhat are you doing?

original: ああ、健康診断……の様なものだ
traducao: Ah, it is like a physical checkup.

original: 船員は必ず診断を受けなければならないが、\n俺達の様な種族の、専門家がいないのでな
traducao: All crew members must be examined,\nyet there is no specialist for our races.

original: 簡単な判別しか出来んが、俺もこうして\n手伝いをしている
traducao: I can only do basic checks,\nbut I am assisting like this.

original: ほら、普通の人にはわかりづらい事とか\n言いづらい事とか……あるだろ？
traducao: Y'know, there are things regular folks\ndon't get, or things hard to talk about.

original: なるほどね……
traducao: I see...

original: あれ、じゃあもしかして\nカイウスは健康診断、二種類受けなくちゃ\nいけないんだ？
traducao: Wait, so does that mean\nCaius has to take two kinds\nof health exams?

original: そうなんだよ……。\nほんと、まいるぜ……
traducao: Yeah, exactly...\nIt really wears me out...

original: ところで、エミルこそこんな所で\n何してたんだ？
traducao: By the way, Emil, what were you\ndoing here in a place like this?

original: ふむ。\nそれは俺も訊こうと思っていた
traducao: Hm.\nI was about to ask that as well.

original: クィッキー！！
traducao: Quickieee!!

original: あ……僕？
traducao: Ah... Me?

original: 僕は、その……。\n何か、みんなの事見てると
traducao: I, well...\nWatching everyone...

original: 仲間の事を思い出して……。\n何か、和むっていうか……
traducao: reminded me of my companions...\nIt kind of puts me at ease...

original: ……クィ？
traducao: ...Qui?

original: あ、あの……ユージーンさん？\n私に、何か……？
traducao: U-Um... Eugene?\nIs there something on me...?

original: いや……これは失礼した
traducao: ...No, forgive my staring.

original: フィリアはいつも\n綺麗な三つ編みをしている……\nと、思ってな……
traducao: I was just thinking that\nPhilia always wears\nsuch lovely braids...

original: 私の、三つ編み……ですか？
traducao: My... braids, you mean?

original: ああ。\nキッチリ結っている様で、それでいて\n繊細な柔らかさを感じさせる……
traducao: Indeed.\nThey seem neatly tied, yet evoke\nsuch delicate softness...

original: そ、そんな事……
traducao: N-Not at all...

original: ユージーンさんの三つ編みだって\nいつも乱れ一つなくて\n素敵だと思います
traducao: Eugene's braids are always\nso flawlessly neat,\nI think they look wonderful too!

original: そうか？
traducao: Is that so?

original: ええ、そうですよ。\n日頃から、身だしなみに\n気を配られているのがよくわかります
traducao: Yes, absolutely.\nIt clearly shows how attentive\nyou are to your grooming!

original: …………そうか
いや……。\nありがとう
traducao: Well then...\nThank you.

original: ……いいえ……どういたしまして
traducao: ...No... you're very welcome.

original: ふふ……
traducao: Fufu...

original: あの……ユージーンさん？\n聞いてもいいでしょうか
traducao: Um... Eugene?\nMay I ask you something?

original: ふむ、何だ
traducao: Hm, what is it?

original: ユージーンさんは\nどうしていつも髪を\n三つ編みにされているんですか？
traducao: Why do you always\nwear your hair in braids,\nEugene?

original: これか……。\n伸ばす事を決めた時に、\nとある人から教わったのだ
traducao: This...?\nWhen I decided to grow it out,\na certain person taught me.

original: 公式な場でボサボサというわけにもいかないし\n戦いにおいても具合が悪い
traducao: Messy hair won't do at formal events,\nand it gets in the way during battle.

original: 編むのに時間はかかるが……。\nまあ、身だしなみという奴だ
traducao: It takes time to braid, but...\nwell, it is a matter of grooming.

original: そうだったんですか……
traducao: Is that what happened...?

original: 戦いの場だけじゃなく、\n普段の身だしなみの事も\n考えられているなんて……
traducao: Thinking not just of combat,\nbut also about your everyday\ngrooming as well...

original: 素敵ですね。\n大人の男性、という感じがします
traducao: How wonderful.\nYou truly feel like a mature gentleman.

original: む……そうか？
traducao: Hm... do I?

original: はい
traducao: Yes!

original: ……そう言われると……何だか\nくすぐったい様な気分になるな……
traducao: ...Being told that makes me feel\na bit tickled, somehow...

original: ……ふふ
traducao: ...Fufu.

original: あ……ユージーンさん
traducao: Ah... Eugene.

original: こんにちは
traducao: Hello.

original: ああ
traducao: Yeah.

original: いつもマオと親しく\nしてくれている様だな。\n迷惑をかける事もあるだろうが……
traducao: You always seem to get along\nso well with Mao.\nHe may cause trouble at times, but...

original: 良ければ、これからも\nマオの事をよろしく頼む
traducao: Please continue to look after\nMao going forward.

original: そ、そんな事……！\nボクだって、マオみたいな友達が出来て\n嬉しくて……ええと……
traducao: N-Not at all!\nI'm happy to have a friend like Mao,\nso... um...

original: ふふ、そうか
traducao: Fufu, I see.

original: マオはいい友達を持った様だな
traducao: It seems Mao has found a good friend.

original: ……ユージーンさんは、本当に\nマオのお父さんみたいな人ですね
traducao: ...You really are like\na father to Mao, Eugene.

original: お父さん？　\n俺が？
traducao: A father?\nMe?

original: ふっ……
traducao: Heh...

original: えっ……どうして笑うんですか？\nボク、何かおかしな事……
traducao: Eh...? Why are you laughing?\nDid I say something weird...?

original: ああ、いや、違うんだ
traducao: Ah, no, that's not it.

original: 以前事情があって、ある検問を通る際\n身分を詐称する必要があったんだが
traducao: Due to circumstances in the past,\nwe had to fake our identities at a gate.

original: その時、俺はマオに\n召使い役を言い渡されてな
traducao: Back then, Mao assigned me\nthe role of his servant.

original: 召使い！？
traducao: A servant?!

original: 父親役では無理があったらしい。\nふふ……懐かしいな
traducao: Apparently a father role was too absurd.\nFufu... How nostalgic.

original: でも、よりによって\n召使いって……
traducao: Still, of all things,\na servant...?

original: ほんと、変なところでマオは\n独創性を発揮するんだから……
traducao: Mao really shows his creativity\nin the weirdest ways...

original: リフィルはハーフエルフなのだと\n聞いたのだが……本当なのか？
traducao: I heard you are a half-elf, Raine...\nIs that true?

original: ……ええ、そうよ
traducao: ...Yes, it is.

original: ……そうか
traducao: ...I see.

original: ……ハーフエルフの教師では\nご不満かしら？
traducao: ...Are you dissatisfied\nwith a half-elf teacher?

original: いや……、そういうわけではない。\nむしろ喜ばしい事だと思っている
traducao: No... not at all.\nRather, I consider it a great joy.

original: ……そうかしら。\n買い被り過ぎではなくて？
traducao: ...Is that so?\nAren't you giving me too much credit?

original: いや、種族は違えど\n同じヒト……それを肌で感じる\n良いきっかけになるだろう
traducao: No. Though races differ, we are\nall human... It is a fine chance\nto experience that firsthand.

original: そういう意味で……失礼かもしれんが\nリフィルが教師として来てくれて\n良かったと思っている
traducao: In that sense... excuse my bluntness,\nbut I am glad Raine came here\nas a teacher.

original: なるほど……そういう事ね
traducao: I see... So that is what you meant.

original: ……まだ、私に\n何が出来るかわからないけれど。\n期待に添えるよう、力を尽くすわ
traducao: ...I still don't know\nwhat I can accomplish,\nbut I will do my best to help.

original: ああ……よろしく頼む
traducao: Yeah... I count on you.

original: 珍しいわね。\nあなたがそんな険しい顔をするなんて
traducao: How unusual.\nFor you to wear such a grim expression.

original: ……ああ、リフィルか
traducao: ...Ah, Raine, is it?

original: いや、今度の食事当番が\n俺に回ってくる事になったんだが……。\n何を作ったものかと思ってな
traducao: The upcoming cooking duty\nhas fallen to me...\nI was wondering what to prepare.

original: あら、意外な事で悩んでいるのね。\n料理は苦手？
traducao: Oh, what an unexpected worry.\nAre you bad at cooking?

original: 苦手というより、俺が作るのは\n軍隊仕込みの素朴なものだ。\n若者の口には合わないかもしれん
traducao: Rather than bad, what I make\nis simple military rations.\nIt may not suit youth's tastes.

original: 若者だからこそ、どんなものでも\n美味しく感じるのではないかしら
traducao: Because they are young, wouldn't they\nfind almost anything delicious?

original: ……ふむ。\nなるほどな
traducao: ...Hm.\nThat is a fair point.

original: それに、軍隊仕込みの料理というのは\n特に栄養バランスに配慮されたものが\n多いのでしょう？
traducao: Besides, military cooking\noften places great importance\non nutritional balance, right?

original: ある意味、これ以上若者にとって\nふさわしい料理はないのではなくて？
traducao: In a sense, isn't there no better meal\nfor growing youth than that?

original: ふ……、さすがは教師だな
traducao: Heh... Truly spoken like a teacher.

original: あなたも、その発想や悩み方が\nいかにも軍人という感じね
traducao: And your reasoning and worries\nare thoroughly like a soldier's.

original: お互い様……というわけか。\nなるほどな……ふふ
traducao: Two of a kind, then.\nI suppose you're right... fufu.

original: ねーねー、ユージーン。\nボクの手の指、好きなの握ってみて
traducao: Hey, hey, Eugene!\nGrip any finger on my hand you like!

original: ん？　\n手の指？
traducao: Hm?\nA finger?

original: いきなり何を……
traducao: What is this all of a sudden...?

original: いいからいいから！\nちょっとした心理テストだヨ
traducao: Just do it, just do it!\nIt's a little personality test!

original: ふむ、なるほどな。\n……では、これか？
traducao: Hm, I see.\n...Then this one?

original: 中指かぁ……
traducao: The middle finger, huh...

original: ……えへへ、ありがと。\n自分と同じ立場って見てくれてるんだね
traducao: ...Ehehe, thank you!\nYou see me as your equal, don't you?

original: ……ああ
traducao: ...Yeah.

original: マオは同じヒトで、仲間で\n家族だからな
traducao: Mao is a fellow human, a comrade,\nand family to me, after all.

original: ユージーン……
traducao: Eugene...

original: ところで、その心理テストに\n信憑性はあるのか？
traducao: By the way, is that personality test\nactually credible?

original: さあ？　\nどうだろ
traducao: Who knows?\nI wonder!

original: でもさ、合ってるかわからないから\nみんなに試してみようって思ったんだよネ！
traducao: Since I wasn't sure if it worked,\nI thought I'd test it on everyone!

original: 俺は実験体にされたのか……
traducao: So I was your guinea pig...

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 笑い。\n
traducao: Laughter.\n
